generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The intending tenderer is instructed to note that they should abide by the detailed instructions and conditions contained in the standard tender documents KW-3 K.P.W.D. and further orders there on.
All necessary drawings, paper works, etc. and any other informations required to be observed shall be the responsibility of contractor.
Whenever executing authority insist proof of having purchased the materials (used during executing the work) for verification. The contractor has to produce the purchase bills.

As per Karnataka state Government order LD/300/LET/2006 Blore dated 01.01.07 and Government letter no PW/134/BMS/2007 dated 27.07.07, a sum amounting to 1% of the bill amount will be deducted towards constructions labour welfare fund
Conditional tenders are not accepted.

The tenderer shall obtain the work done certificate in the prescribed format from the competent Authority Executive Engineer (District level Officer) and scan the original Certificate and attach the scanned file Certificate/ Certificates, which shall be produced at the time of opening of technical Bids for physical verification.
Financial year will be reckoned as the period between first day of April and thirty first day of March inclusive
The employer reserves the rights to reject one or all tender without assigning any reason.
Tenderer shall note, that the tenderers those found Eligible to the conditions mentioned in Section-3 Qualification Instructions to Tenderers (ITT) will only be considered for further evaluation
The employer is not responsible for any delay in accessing E- procurement portal

All the items includes all Leads and Lifts, Loading and Unloading, transportation charges, Cost of all materials, Labour, HOM of machineries as per Standard specifications and as directed by the Engineer-in-charge of the work and all other incidental items which are necessary for the successful completion of the work
The bidder should upload valid KPWD Class III Civil License and above Civil Contractor with PWD, Govt. of Karnataka and should have suitable technical, financial & managerial capabilities
The contractor shall not deviate/alter/execute excess quantities or additional items without the prior approval of the employer.
The Cost of the tender form shall not be refundable.
Further particulars, if any, required by the contractor can be had from the O/o the Executive Engineer, No.1 buildings Division during office hours.
Agency Should upload Employees provident fund (EPF) & ESI registration certificate, and also should upload copy of receipt of the last six months for the payment made for the same
The Tenderer should submit Latest GST clearance certificate
The quantities shown in the schedule are approximate. The actual quantities will be executed as per site condition only. Any balance materials shall be taken back by the contractor
Tenderer should be registered in labour department & submit labour registration certificate
Tenderers must provide the address with valid proof of address along with latest photographs of all the employees who are employed in this work to the concerned authority
The Labours deployed shall mandatorily wear the face mask, hand gloves and take all safety measures to protect labours and staff

Bidder should upload the bid capacity calculated as per KW-3 tender condition, The statements showing the value of existing commitments and on-going works as well as the stipulated period of completion remaining for each of the works listed should be countersigned by the Employer in charge, not below the rank of an Executive Engineer or equivalent. False representations in the statements leads to disqualification of the tender as per clause 3.6
Bidder Shall Abide by the Prevailing Labour laws and minimum wages act.
Bidder shall pay Contract Management Module processing fees of 0.025% of the contact value (Min Rs.500/- & Max Rs.7500/-) soon after contract has been issued to bidder
The Quoted Rates Shall be excluding GST

technicalCriterionList.description: 3.2 To qualify for award of this contract, each Tenderer in its name should have in the last five years i.e. 2021-22 to 2025-26 b)Satisfactory completed as prime contractor,atleast one similar work to an extent of 50% of the cost of the work i.e. Rs 40.52 Lakhs

3.2 To qualify for award of this contract, each Tenderer in its name should have in the last five years (i.e. 2021-22 to 2025-26) (c) Executed in any One year, the minimum quantities of work as follows : (A. Fire Man / Mechanic Class-1/Pump/Motor/Machine Operator/ Helper / R.O.Water plant operator -3252 Mandays),(B.Cleaning of Water Storage Tank or Sump-1410151 Ltr)

3.2 To qualify for award of this contract, each Tenderer in its name should have in the last five years (i.e. 2021-22 to 2025-26) (e) The Tenderer or his identified sub-contractor should possess valid license for executing water supply/sanitary engineering works and should have executed similar water supply/sanitary engineering works totaling Rs. 11.28 lakhs in any one year

3.2 To qualify for award of this contract, each Tenderer in its name should have in the last five years i.e. 2021-22 to 2025-26 a)Achieved in at least two financial years an average annual financial turnover of Rs.81.05 lakhs

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

technicalCriterionList.description: 3.3 Each Tenderer should further demonstrate: (b)Liquid assets and /or availability of credit facilities of not less than: Rs.24.31 Lakhs (Credit lines/ letter of credit/ certificates from nationalized/Scheduled banks) for meeting the fund requirement etc. should be enclosed in prescribed format.

3.6.Tenderers who meet the above specified minimum qualifying criteria, will only be qualified, if their available tender capacity is more than the total tender value. The available tender capacity will be calculated as under: Assessed available tender capacity (AxNx2.5- B) Where A is Maximum value of civil engineering works executed in any one year during the last five years taking into account the completed as well as works in progress. N is Number of years prescribed for completion of the works for which tenders are invited 12 month. B is Value, at 2026-27 price level, of existing commitments and on-going works to be completed during the next 12 month. Note The statements showing the value of existing commitments and on-going works as well as the stipulated period of completion remaining for each of the works listed should be countersigned by the Employer in charge, not below the rank of an Executive Engineer or equivalent
